component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.evidence: Spans the copilot-cli-otlp plugin (plugin.ts extractHookContext + transitionGate), a new copilot-cli-otlp.evidence.ts (copilotRouteProof, copilotEvidenceInputs, isKnownSession), shared core evidence contract (record-store.ts agent field, stamp.ts EvidenceInputs.agent, session-scope.ts new currentGeneration) and the proxy spool sender (evidence-send.ts sendGuard). Shared utilities bumped +1 for core contract touch.

requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.evidence: Goal and never-claim cases were clear (native/BYOK/non-SSO), but three follow-up fix commits (session binding, sticky attribution, known-session hold) show edge semantics emerged during build; behaviours now pinned by funding test file.

technical_risk.label: XL
technical_risk.evidence: Privacy/attribution-sensitive: fail-closed transitionGate with stop markers, route proof from env exports, login/profile change handling, resume and nested-native-Copilot spoofing. Closest pattern is Claude managed-launch proof, which was reused by mapping COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL onto ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; it does not cover pinned-session binding or independent collection generation, so risk bumped. Many enumerated edge cases covered by new tests.

file_change_estimate.label: XL
file_change_estimate.evidence: About 12 files in the frozen diff: 5 production modified (plugin.ts, record-store.ts, session-scope.ts, stamp.ts, evidence-send.ts), 1 new production (copilot-cli-otlp.evidence.ts), 1 doc (ARCHITECTURE-OTLP-PLUGIN.md), 1 new unit test (copilot-cli-otlp.funding.test.ts, +3 tests later), 3 e2e files (backend_app.py, drive-copilot.mjs, run-copilot-funding.sh). Roughly half are test/e2e/docs.

dependencies.label: XS
dependencies.evidence: No new packages or manifest changes; reuses ProviderRegistry, routing.ts, record-store and existing evidence modules.

affected_layers.label: L
affected_layers.evidence: Service (plugin hook adapter), DB-Persistence (file-based evidence record and stop markers, new agent field validated on read), Infrastructure (proxy otlp-spool sender guard) and External (X-CodeMie-Funding-Route/Subscription-Type headers to backend, e2e mock backend).

key_reasoning.reason: Plugin plus shared core evidence contract plus proxy sender; a new agent discriminator flows through stamp, record store, session scope and sender.
Security/privacy-sensitive sticky funding attribution with fail-closed gating; no exact precedent for independent collection generation.
About 12 files including new module, unit test and e2e harness.
Service, persistence, proxy infrastructure and backend header contract.
